verdict.rationale: Omnara has a dedicated event-webhooks docs page saying users can configure an event webhook that receives JSON POST requests carrying `event` and `data`. That is a registrable outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. The Slack connector is a chat integration and is not credited. missing for 10: list of subscribable event types, signature/verification and retry/delivery-guarantee details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Configure an event webhook to receive JSON POST requests with `event` and `data`.
